html:
SMTO-LLM-0021 — This task was started with a different model than the one set now

GUID: 8a3dce74-b115-4f2b-aa54-c0d992e4191c
Slug: model-profile-incompatible
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: provider

What happened

  • A stopped task keeps the model it started with. The model now chosen in Settings is different, or the task never recorded one, so SMTO won't continue it with another model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main card, set Model back to the model you used when this task started, and select Save Main. A stopped task can only continue with the same model, so its plan and earlier steps stay consistent.
  2. On the stopped task, select Resume (or Continue task if that is what it shows). Once the models match, the task picks up where it stopped and keeps its finished steps.
  3. If you can't use that model any more, or the task never recorded one, start the remaining work as a new task instead. A new task uses the current model from the start, so the mismatch no longer applies.

What success looks like

  • The task resumes and shows new activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO's model settings. Before starting a new task, check what the stopped task already finished so nothing is done twice. Don't edit or delete the task's saved data to force it onto another model.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Resuming a saved run was refused because the role's configured model differs from the model recorded in the run's saved profile, or the run recorded no resolved model (model_profile_incompatible).

What this means

  • Resume compares the saved model profile with the selected configuration and rejects incompatible identity or reservation values instead of silently replacing them. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Resume compares the saved model profile with the selected configuration and rejects incompatible identity or reservation values instead of silently replacing them.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the saved resolved model and token reservation with the selected model profile; distinguish an unresolved old automatic selection from a changed explicit model.

How to fix it

  • Compare the run's saved model profile with the role's configured model in Settings › Setup › Model routing, then set the role back to the recorded model (with the same endpoint serving it, or Auto-select model on) before resuming. A run saved without a resolved model (Auto) cannot be resumed; start a new task instead. If the message reports an unsupported constrained recovery thinking profile, set recovery thinking to auto, enabled, budget, disabled or unchanged.
  • Restore the saved model and its context capacity before resuming.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Resume preparation accepts the saved profile without silently substituting a model.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
